definition: Computed by a proportion pack rather than stated outright: the figure is worked out from the building's own dimensions, and the number shown is its value in a stated reference case. A Georgian cornice height is derived from a Gibbs Ionic entablature.
basis: schema/kit.schema.json, on a figure's kind: "derived: computed from a proportion pack." On its expression: "Evaluable by the proportion engine in the bound context." On the stored value: "The value the expression yields in a stated reference context, so the file is readable by a person and not only by an engine." kits/georgian-colonial-american.kit.json eave_condition.cornice_height_in.note: "the cornice member of the Gibbs Ionic entablature, taken at the storey".
